# Banavaram Charan — Professional Portfolio
> Business Analyst · Data Analyst · Software Developer

## Summary
Banavaram Charan connects business operations, data analysis, and software engineering to build practical, secure, and structured technology solutions. Experienced in banking operations, financial liabilities servicing, payment gateway settlement, Maker–Checker risk controls, and practical software development.

## Current Experience
- Apprentice – Financial Liabilities Operations (WRB), Standard Chartered Bank GBS, Bengaluru, India (October 2025 – Present)
- Core Focus: High-volume financial transaction servicing, payment gateway settlement and refund processing (Razorpay, Paytm, PayU, CCAvenue, TPSL, BillDesk, Atom), discrepancy investigation, Maker–Checker authorization, deposit and liability servicing, daily Excel MIS reporting, and process improvement.

## Verified Projects
1. Smart Print: Web-based secure print management platform with temporary document uploads, dynamic 6-digit PIN and QR verification, printer selection, and automated file deletion (React.js, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, MySQL/PostgreSQL).
2. Cloud Secure Storage Mechanism (CSSM): Cloud storage security framework combining data dispersion and cryptographic encryption to distribute fragmented data securely across cloud endpoints (OpenStack Swift).
3. iHealthcare: Automated medical image processing workflow with built-in patient data masking (PII sanitization) for secure clinical review (Python, Medical Image Processing).
4. YouTube Adview Prediction: Machine learning regression project predicting YouTube video ad views based on engagement metrics, where Random Forest Regressor demonstrated top performance (Python, scikit-learn, Pandas).
5. Predictive Maintenance Framework: IoT framework collecting sensor telemetry via MQTT to monitor equipment conditions and identify anomalies proactively (Arduino, ESP8266, MQTT, Advantech Cloud PaaS, Node-RED).
